rationale: Committed before the first validation run; this file's git history is the provenance that the bounds were not fitted to results. critical_miss_rate is zero-tolerance: a judge that passes an answer which would cost the asker an enrollment window, a penalty, or coverage is unfit regardless of agreement. agreement 0.85 allows about one disagreement in seven on a deliberately hard golden set. invalid_output_rate 0.02: structured outputs make malformed verdicts near-impossible, so more indicates a wiring fault. self_consistency 0.90 across repeated runs; it is absent when runs = 1, which fails the gate, because single-run evidence cannot approve an evaluator.
